title: Set up a replacement Zebra DS3608-SR scanner using Barcode Interface (hardware connect + connectivity + calibration)
summary: Set up a replacement Zebra DS3608-SR scanner so the Barcode Interface application shows healthy connectivity and the scanner is calibrated when the app connectivity indicator is red.
when_to_use: Use when a Zebra DS3608-SR scanner has been replaced and needs setup so Barcode Interface connectivity is healthy; if the Barcode Interface connectivity indicator is red, calibration is required.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Perform the scanner dock/cabling connection, launch Barcode Interface, verify the connectivity indicator, and run calibration when the indicator is red.
access_or_tools_needed: USB cable with RJ45 side (to dock) and USB to laptop
Network connectivity to the AGV control and Hospital control at the laptop (validated by pinging their IP addresses)

access_required: FORTNA account login on the Windows laptop
system_preconditions: Barcode Interface.exe is installed on the Windows 10/11 laptop (found on the desktop with a FORTNA logo).
Scanner dock, USB cable, and power adapter are available for the replacement Zebra DS3608-SR scanner.
Laptop has network connectivity to the AGV control and Hospital control (validated by pinging their IP addresses).

steps.title: Verify laptop and Barcode Interface availability; log in with a FORTNA account
steps.purpose: Ensure the setup laptop can run Barcode Interface and is authenticated before connecting and configuring the scanner.
steps.instruction: On the Windows 10/11 laptop, confirm Barcode Interface.exe is installed (on the desktop with a FORTNA logo), then log into the laptop with a FORTNA account.
steps.expected_result: You are logged into the Windows laptop with a FORTNA account and Barcode Interface.exe is available to launch.
steps.healthy_condition: Barcode Interface.exe is present on the desktop and you can proceed to launch it.
steps.failure_condition: Barcode Interface.exe is not available or you cannot log in with a FORTNA account.

actions.label: Confirm Barcode Interface.exe and login
actions.exact_action: Log into the laptop with a FORTNA account.

steps.title: Connect scanner dock cabling and power; confirm dock lights up
steps.purpose: Provide power and connectivity path from the scanner dock to the laptop so the scanner can charge and Barcode Interface can detect connectivity.
steps.instruction: Connect the RJ45 side of the USB cable to the back of the scanner dock, connect the USB to the laptop, and connect the auxiliary cable to the power adapter. Plug the power adapter into a 120 VAC outlet (x2). Confirm the dock lights up.
steps.expected_result: The scanner dock powers on and its lights are on.
steps.healthy_condition: Dock lights up after the power adapter is plugged into a 120 VAC outlet.
steps.failure_condition: Dock does not light up after connecting power.

actions.label: Connect RJ45/USB/aux power
actions.exact_action: Connect the RJ45 side of the USB cable to the back of the scanner dock, the USB to the laptop, and the auxiliary to the power adapter. Be sure to plug the adapter into a 120 VAC outlet. The dock should light up.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the dock does not light up after connecting power.

steps.title: Charge the scanner on the dock until the battery indicator turns green
steps.purpose: Ensure the replacement scanner has sufficient charge before proceeding to Barcode Interface connectivity checks and calibration.
steps.instruction: If the scanner is uncharged, place it on the dock until the red battery symbol shown on top turns green.
steps.expected_result: Scanner battery indicator changes from red to green.
steps.healthy_condition: Battery indicator on top of the scanner is green.
steps.failure_condition: Battery indicator does not turn green after resting on the dock.

actions.label: Check battery indicator color
actions.exact_action: If the scanner is uncharged it will need to rest on the dock until the red battery symbol shown on top turns green.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the scanner battery indicator does not turn green after resting on the dock.

steps.title: Launch Barcode Interface application
steps.purpose: Open the application that displays connectivity status and provides the calibration action when connectivity is red.
steps.instruction: Launch the Barcode Interface application (should be on the desktop).
steps.expected_result: Barcode Interface is open and the screen is ready for connectivity status verification.
steps.healthy_condition: Barcode Interface window is visible and you can view the connectivity indicator at the bottom right of the screen.
steps.failure_condition: Barcode Interface does not launch or the connectivity indicator is not visible.

actions.label: Open Barcode Interface
actions.exact_action: Launch the Barcode Interface application. This should be on the desktop.

steps.title: Check Barcode Interface connectivity indicator (bottom right)
steps.purpose: Determine whether the scanner needs calibration based on the app connectivity status.
steps.instruction: Check the connectivity indicator at the bottom right of the Barcode Interface screen.
steps.expected_result: Connectivity indicator is either green or red.

actions.label: Observe connectivity indicator
actions.exact_action: Check connectivity on the bottom right of the screen.

steps.title: Calibrate scanner only if connectivity indicator is red
steps.purpose: Restore healthy scanner connectivity by running calibration when the app reports red connectivity.
steps.instruction: If the connectivity indicator is red, click "Calibrate Scanner" and follow the onscreen instructions until calibration completes.
steps.expected_result: After calibration, the operator observes the connectivity indicator change to green.
steps.healthy_condition: Connectivity indicator becomes green after calibration.
steps.failure_condition: Connectivity indicator remains red after clicking "Calibrate Scanner" and following the onscreen instructions.

actions.label: Run calibration
actions.exact_action: If red, click "Calibrate Scanner" and follow the onscreen instructions.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the Barcode Interface connectivity indicator remains red after clicking "Calibrate Scanner" and following the onscreen instructions.

steps.title: Skip calibration if connectivity indicator is green
steps.purpose: Avoid unnecessary calibration when the scanner already reports healthy connectivity.
steps.instruction: If the connectivity indicator is green, skip calibration and proceed to the next step of the overall scanner setup procedure.
steps.expected_result: Connectivity indicator is green and calibration is not performed.
steps.failure_condition: Connectivity indicator is not green (red) but calibration is skipped.

success_criteria: Barcode Interface connectivity indicator at the bottom right is green.
If connectivity was red initially, calibration was run and the operator observes the connectivity indicator change to green.
Scanner battery indicator is green (if it was initially red).
healthy_conditions: Scanner dock lights up after power is connected.
Scanner battery indicator turns green after charging on the dock.
Barcode Interface connectivity indicator at bottom right is green.
failure_conditions: Dock does not light up after connecting power.
Scanner battery indicator does not turn green after resting on the dock.
Barcode Interface connectivity indicator remains red after clicking "Calibrate Scanner" and following onscreen instructions.
escalation_guidance: If the dock does not light up after connecting power, stop and escalate.
If the scanner battery indicator does not turn green after resting on the dock, stop and escalate.
If the Barcode Interface connectivity indicator remains red after calibration, stop and escalate.
